summary: Full-stack verification of the new Branded Stock by Customer report (per-distributor Stock Dashboard tab + global /stock-dashboard 'Branded Stock' tab). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass in test_iteration_323_branded_stock_sections.py — validates (a) global GET /api/distributors/dashboard/stock-summary returns branded_stock with the 24 Brand section (total=409, generic=209, customer=200; Drive Folder Test Lead 200); (b) per-distributor GET /api/distributors/b8876367.../stock-dashboard returns exactly 1 branded_stock section (total=400, generic=200 'Generic (unclassified)' @ Default master, customer 200 for Drive Folder Test Lead referencing branded child ba79db11); (c) regression — all legacy keys (summary/by_distributor/by_sku/by_location/cities and totals/skus/factory_warehouses/bottle_tracking) still present, populated, unchanged in shape; (d) cross-endpoint section shape consistency. Frontend: Playwright verified the distributor detail tab renders sku-stock-table AND branded-stock-by-customer with the correct testids (branded-stock-section-{sku_id}, branded-generic-{sku_id}, branded-customers-{sku_id}, branded-loc-chip-*), showing 400 Bottle total, generic 200 Bottle @ Default master, Drive Folder Test Lead 200 Bottle w/ child SKU + location chip. Bottles↔Default Crates toggle switches without breaking either table (24 Brand packaging has units=1 so numbers stay same, which matches the parent SKU table). Global /stock-dashboard 'Branded Stock' tab (tab-branded-stock badge=1) opens branded-stock-panel showing '24 Brand — 409 units total', Generic 209 (Default master 200 + Noida Factory Warehouse 9), Customer 'Drive Folder Test Lead' 200. Legacy tabs By Location / By SKU / By Distributor / Safety Overview all click through without visible errors.

issues: Quantity labels render as generic 'units' (fallback) on the global Branded Stock panel (e.g. '409 units total', '200 units'), whereas the per-distributor Stock Dashboard tab shows the SKU's baseUnit ('Bottle') for the identical data. Cosmetic inconsistency — likely a pkgBySku lookup that supplies baseUnit only on the per-distributor page. Consider wiring the same lookup on StockDashboard.jsx so global users see 'Bottle' instead of the fallback 'units'.

action_items: OPTIONAL (cosmetic): populate pkgBySku on /stock-dashboard so the global Branded Stock panel renders the SKU's baseUnit (e.g. 'Bottle') instead of the generic 'units' fallback — brings it in line with the per-distributor tab.
critical_code_review_comments: _build_branded_stock_sections (distributors.py:3798) iterates children twice (once to collect branded_parents, again per-section to filter by parent) — O(N_children * N_parents). Fine for current tenants but a pre-computed dict-by-parent would be O(N).

Frontend BrandedStockSections keys child rows on `entry.child_sku_id || \`un-${i}\`` — ok for a single generic-unclassified row, but if a section ever has multiple 'unrecognised classification' entries at the same time (all with child_sku_id=null shape but different real ids), the fallback list-index key is fine because null-id entries are guaranteed single per section (only the None key). Not an issue today.
